batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c GB Hogg b Pankaj Singh

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c AL Menaria b GB Hogg

batting.name: KP Pietersen
batting.dismissal: c R Dravid b AA Chavan

batting.name: Y Nagar
batting.dismissal: c AA Chavan b A Singh

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c R Dravid b A Singh

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c AB Agarkar b IK Pathan

balls.text: on the middle stump and that has been swung away to the leg side for a four to get Delhi to their 150. Excellent last over for the home team!
slower one, and Nagar goes for another shot over long-on, that connected well to the deep mid-wicket region but to the fielder.
another full-toss and that has been dispatched over deep square-leg for another six, poor, poor bowling and it seems like Cooper has done some damage to his knee at the boundary
down the pitch and this is a quicker one, he gets an outside edge and goes over short third-man for a four!
slower, outside the off-stump, beaten and the keeper collects well and removes the bails. Appeal for a stumping.
full-toss and that has been deposited into the stands over deep mid-wicket! The batsman was coming down the pitch as well and that is a good start to the over.
quick, yorker and dug out by Pathan, but fails to get it any other place but back to the bowler.
slower outside the off stump, 108 km/hr, tries to cut but gets it only up to the point region
a wide this time, down the leg-side, the batsman isn't reading Cooper too well and that is making it difficult for him to get any bat on it.
on his pads, pitched outside the leg and misses the bat, some appeal but they are off for a leg-bye
some bounce there or was it a case of playing on the front foot to a ball pitched up, tries to defend, hits his gloves and it rolls over to the off side
slower ball, shorter as well and Pathan taps it away to the leg side for a single
on his pads, fuller and flicked away to the deep square-leg region and they sprint well for a couple.
slower, pitched up and it is well caught by Dravid. He was bowling almost all of them slow this over, and this time it was in the batsman's half too, mistimed it badly though and that is well-taken.
slower one yet again and he goes for a big one, misses by a mile, and goes to the keeper on the bounce.
slower one, tries to slog it away, gets a bit of an edge and goes to the deep square-leg for a single
finally a four, full-toss, a low one and that is drilled through the wide long-off region for a four. Hogg was not quick enough to get there.
full-toss and flicked away to the fine-leg, would have wanted to get it away for a four.
slower, outside the off stump, cut away and that sizzles through to deep point but only for a single
short of length and the batsman was almost waiting for a slower one, it was quicker this time and the pull shot does not connect.
quicker down the leg side, does not get any timing on it and misses it. Hits the pad and they are away for a single
very slow, rolled his fingers over it and beats the batsman
yorker length again and driven to the off side for a single

quicker this time and pitched right up to the bat, missed and there was an appeal for an lbw, not-out given. Cooper tried to kick the ball to the stumps because the batsman was out of his crease, it missed the stumps and they go for an overthrow.
slower, floated it up outside the off stump and the batsman waits for a while before he decides to dab it to the off side for a single
beaten to a yorker! Pitched right up, missed completely, there was an appeal for an lbw but the umpire calls it a bye after the wicket-keeper missed it too.
Ooo! Much slower, wrong 'un and he tries to go for a slog sweep and misses it completely!
shot and that is a six! It has almost come out of nowhere, he has only just come at the crease, it was pitched up and Ojha goes over long-off
wrong 'un from Hogg, shorter and he is able to play it away to the off side for a single
driven on the front foot to the right of Hogg, who fields.
straighter one, defended on the back-foot to the off side and they take a single to point
comes down the pitch and taps it away to the covers.
outside the off-stump and defended on the front foot, bit of a misunderstanding but in the end they do not go for a run
outside the off stump and plays it late to third-man for a single.

gone, bowled! He was playing many of these strokes, going outside the off-stump to flick it away to the leg side for a single or two, this time he failed to read the pace of the ball, missed the ball and is castled.
on the back foot and defended to the off side for a single
outside the off stump, goes down the pitch, driven to the covers for a quick single. Cooper fields but does not have a shy at the stumps.

pitched right up, comes on to the front foot, plays it to the right of Hogg, who gives it a run, fields off his own bowling and despite the batsman wanting to go for it, prevents the possibility of a single
flicked away to the leg side for a single
wrong 'un and Taylor defends on the front foot, almost flat-bats it like Ravi Shastri in his heydays.
played forward, to the leg side and is off the mark
on the middle, Taylor comes forward, tapped away to the leg-side.

caught at sweeper, gone! This was shorter from Hogg and Sehwag went on to the back foot and tried to cut it away, but got the ball more in air than on the ground and the fielder dived in front to take a good catch under pressure.
length ball, on his pads, flicked away to the leg side, where the deep square leg has to rush to his right to clean up.
outside the off stump, full and he tries to dab it to third-man but misses
on his pads yet again and this time he has drilled it to the deep square-leg for a couple of runs.
shorter, down the leg side and Taylor misses. He has a puzzled look why the umpire did not call that wide.
pitched a little up this time and driven, yet again to the short cover.
good length, on the up and driven to the short covers.
outside the off-stump, Taylor moves to the off as well and punches it to the deep mid-wicket fielder as well for a single
he is toying with the bowling, almost looking bored, looking for a challenge, moves around in the crease and finally decides to play it to the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
and against Taylor, he pitches them up and is driven to long-on for a single
short from the bowler, Sehwag rocks back and hits it hard but to the long-on fielder.
almost walking into the shot and driving it to the leg side for a single
pitched right up and driven through to the wide long-off for a couple
he is not sparing anyone, not even Hogg, who has had a good time in the IPL, was shorter in length and that is pulled away to mid-wicket for a four!
goes on to his back foot and taps it to the leg-side for a single
misfielded and a second for Taylor. Defended on the back foot to the leg side, takes a single, the sliding stop does not come off and they are able to take two.
shorter from Hogg and cut away through the covers for a single
goes for a big one and connects! Hogg pitched it up to the bat and Sehwag has managed to give himself room and lofting it over long-on
short from Hogg, Taylor sees it early, wants to pull it but does not get it off the middle. Single is the result.

Ho ho! Half-century for Sehwag and that is his fourth successive half century this season, becoming the first batsman ever to do so in IPL history. It was not so short and he still went for the pull, timed very well through mid-wicket for a four!
no late cut this time, he smashes it away through the covers for a four! It was slashed to the right of the point fielder, the man is in form and how.
pitched a little up to the bat, on the off stump and Sehwag tries to late cut it to third-man but gets it only up to the point fielder.
on the front foot and driven to long-on for a single.
bludgeoned straight back, to the right of the bowler and it needs a sliding save from the fielder at long-off to prevent it from going to the fence.
outside the off stump and Taylor cuts it away to the point fielder yet again.
slow, outside the off stump and he tries to cut it away, mistimes it a little but still gets it to deep point for a single
defended back to the bowler and no run for Taylor who has played 14 balls for six.
goes down the track, wants to slay it away, but the ball is slower, never comes on to the bat and he can only manage to get it to long-on for a single.
bouncer, a slower one, and Sehwag lets it go, probably expected a wide for height.
on the off stump, pitched up and Taylor drives it to long-on for a single
on the good length, and middle-stump, flicked it away to the leg side for a single.
flighted but on the pads, Taylor plays it gently to the leg side, stray thoughts of a single are quashed very early.
wrong 'un to Taylor now, who late cuts it but goes to the point fielder.
wrong 'un once again and he picks him well, goes on to the back foot, cuts to point.
outside the leg-stump and turning a little, tapped away to rotate the strike back.
tries to bowl his googly, shorter and picked well by Sehwag, pulls it away but straight to deep square-leg.
shorter from Hogg and Sehwag cuts it away through point, diving stop from Menaria.
and now he goes down the pitch, takes him on the full and driven to long-off.
outside the leg stump after Sehwag moved around to confuse the bowler!
pitched right up and Sehwag gives himself some room and drills it through the covers, goes for a four!
on the pads from over the wicket and misses, hits pads
this time he tries to flick it away off the back foot but the ball hits his pad off an inside edge.
reverse sweep! Sehwag has unleashed a player he rarely plays and he gets it through third-man/fine-leg for a four! Looking dangerous!
pitched right up to the bat, but down the leg-side and Taylor flicks it away to the leg-side for a single
takes a little pace off the ball and Sehwag looked set to give himself some room yet again, tries to drive it through the covers. A bit of mistiming and there is no run.
fullish ball and Sehwag has drilled it over mid-off for a six! That was hit rather flat after the batsman made room and it carried the distance
on the front foot to this good length ball and driven on the up to mid-on for a single
and another one with perfectly the right line and length and Taylor cannot do much apart from defending it back to the bowler.
on the middle stump, pitched up and Taylor has to go forward to defend it back to the bowler.
shortish ball, hurrying on to the batsman, tries to pull it away but beats the bat and hits his pads.
and after bowling one on the off stump, he is back to drifting it to his pads, it is short as well and that is easily pulled away to fine-leg for a four! Finally he gets punished for a poor over.
goes for a big one, over the mid-off fielder but did not get it in the middle of the bat, it went high, not long but the fielder at mid-off Owais Shah, was way too far from the ball.
adjusts his line this time, on the middle and nudged it to the leg side for a single.
fourth ball in a row, on the pads but Taylor misses it this time, making it easy for the umpire to call it a wide.
for the third time in a row, down the leg side, goes for an expansive lofted drive over the leg side but it was a tad too quick there.
on the pads yet again and this time Taylor flicks it away to deep square region yet again.
on his pads, a poor delivery given Sehwag's form and the Powerplay fields, he is only able to get it through to the deep square-leg region for a single
defended a ball outside the off stump, back to the bowler and that ends a decent over from Pankaj Singh.
on the stumps, pitched right up and Taylor defends it back to the bowler
good delivery, on the off-stump, bounced more, quicker and he tried to play it from the back foot, gets the edge and takes it to third-man for a single
flicked through the mid-wicket region and that is gone for four! That is an awesome stroke and for the second time I will have to say that there wasn't too much wrong with the ball!
tries to pull it away but it comes on quicker to him and mistimes it.
on the length, outside the off stump and punched off the back foot to the covers.

gone, caught in the slips! Again, on the back-foot, tries to cut and it takes an edge through to Dravid in the slips, that was travelling quickly and taken well! In fact KP seemed to be coming down the pitch before changing his mind trying for that cut.
length ball on his pads and flicked away to the deep square leg region. They are playing a lot on their back-foot here.
on the pads and this time he is able to go to the back foot and drives to square-leg for a single
over the wicket, pitched up, tries to sweep it and misses.
on the back foot and driven to the covers.
on the back-foot and cuts it away through the covers for four! It was a decently sent down delivery and yet, KP did what he has been doing well this series.

shot in anger and caught! It was on the middle but this is a shot you would probably play towards the end of the innings. He tries to aggressively flick it over fine-leg, got too much under the ball and affords Brad Hogg at the deep square-leg a simple catch.
length ball, drifting a tad down the leg side and Jayawardene dabs it to the leg side.
on the middle, good length, goes on to the back foot and stylishly flicks it away to the deep square-leg region for a single
outside the off stump and he tries to carve it through the covers, to the fielder.

that is a show of form, that is an excellent shot, nothing too wrong with the ball, on the middle stump, clipped off the pads and the fielder at mid-on had given up the chase long before it was through.
on the off-stump, on the length and deviating slightly away from the bat, gets the outside edge and goes through to third-man.
pitched right up and Sehwag was driving that through the covers, gets an inside-edge that goes through fine-leg for a brace. Good over after that first-ball four.
on the length, middle-stump and driven to the off side.
pitched up and Sehwag was going on to his back foot, kept a little low.
little more pitched up and Sehwag tries to go for the cut, straight to point.
shorter again but this time more on the middle stump and turning away, pulled away to the leg side for a single to bring the in-form Sehwag on strike
short ball and outside the off stump, cut away easily by Jayawardene through the gap in the covers.
out, run-out! Missed the bat, and they went for a bye, the wicket-keeper managed to throw the stumps down and Shah is run-out...heart-break for Rahane.
goes to the off-side and plays it to the deep square leg region for a couple. The fielder was up there and they had to come over from mid-wicket.
Woohooo! What a stroke, what a player! Full-toss, low one at that and he has opened his bat for the ball to go over point for a six! I rub my eyes!
tries to slog it over leg-side and gets an inside edge, only for a single.
broken bat! He had just changed the bat and he mistimes it so badly that the handle remains in his hand and the willow made its journey on to the pitch. Only a single.
outside the off stump, full-toss and at 148.5 km/hr and Rahane misses it!

gone, lbw! That was pitched right up to the batsman and Hodge has missed it completely, trying to swing it away and that is as plumb as they come. After hitting the boot, the ball stopped on the crease, and it stopped right in front of the middle stump.
well hit through the leg-side for a couple of runs, it was a full-toss and he heaved it away.
down the leg-side, was it? And not called a wide! Everyone is smiling there, including the batsman and the fielders...!
yorker yet again and he had to dig it out, did it well but gets only a single, 144.5 km/hr
outside the off stump, pitched right up and he tries to go over the extra-cover, misses!
yorker from that height and Rahane fails to get too much on it, back to the bowler.
slower from Yadav, 110.7 km/hr, played away to third-man for a single.
slower one from Yadav and that is played to extra cover for a single.
outside the off-stump, full, widish and Hodge fails to get any bat on it.
shorter, slower, was almost through his shot before checking it and hitting it hard into the ground.
pitched up outside the off stump and he slashes it over cover for another four!
pitched right up to the bat and Hodge wanted to go straight, instead he gets an inside edge and it goes through mid-wicket for a four!
outside the off stump, Hodge opens the face and guides it to third-man for a single.
yorker on the stumps and Hodge's got no option but to defend it back to the bowler.
over extra-cover and that has been tonked away for a four! The required rate's dropping
outside the off-stump, defended on the back foot and single for Rahane.
edged and goes for a four! He tries to open the face of the bat to third-man, but the edge goes very fine and to the fence!
quicker one, short and opens the face of the bat to third-man

unbelievable shot, just amazing! He was moving to outside the off-stump to flick it over fine-leg, it was bowled wide outside the off and opens the face of his bat, goes to the left of point, right of third man and slowly and steadily trickles over for a four!
on the back foot and defended to the off side for a single.
yorker length and Rahane mistimes it over covers, places it between Pietersen and Taylor and it was far away from both.
short of length, quicker, tries to turn it to the leg side but hits the pad and while there was a stifled appeal the batsmen went for a single
slower one on the middle stump, turns it to the leg side for a single
on the middle, dabbed it gently to the off stump and they are away for a single
punched it to the off side and they are off for a quick single, hits the non-striker's stumps direct but the batsman, for the second time in the over, was home.
pitched up on his pads and driven to long-on for a single
goes down the track and hits him inside out over the extra-cover region for a four. A very good shot to reduce some of the pressure.
punched off the back foot for a single to long-off
turning away, played away to the off side and Hodge wanted a quick single, sent back, the throw was a tad wide and the keeper uprooted some of the stumps there! Third umpire called but just in.
goes down the track and lofted it to long-on, goes on a couple of bounces to the fielder
outside the off stump, punched down the ground to long-on for a single

out, caught! What a catch! That was pitched right up to the batsman and Dravid almost drilled it over long-on, but fails to clear it, Agarkar was there, he flung himself behind him and plucked it away easily!
pitched up, goes down the track and driven through the covers for a single
big shout for a leg-before but seemed like it was going down the leg-side, given not-out.
another one down the leg-side and he wanted to sweep this slower one, misses and it is called a wide.
shot over mid-wicket but he does not get too much power there. Only a single
slower one and way down the leg-side, Dravid wanted to have a swipe at it but he misses and it is a huge wide.
pitched up and driven down to long-off for a single
pitched up and driven to mid-off for a single
tries to go over the top but mistimes the stroke and hits it to long-off on the bounce.
late cuts it to third-man for a single now. Doing it well here.
drifts on his pads and that is flicked away to the leg-side for a four! Fifty for the champion batsman!
outside the off stump, slashed away to the third-man for a single
shorter ball and pulled away and for a single.

quicker outside the off-stump, Dravid went for the cut and it has been given out. No, it has not been given out. Sorry, it has been given out after Dravid started walking and then given not-out when he stopped. I dn't know what happened there.
slower outside the off-stump and Dravid checks his shot, just manages to get it over extra cover for a couple.
Pathan's continuing to pitch them up, and he has driven it to long-off for another run
slow ball, pitched right up and tries to hit it hard and to long-off
slower, outside the off stump and driven to long-off for a single
slower, on the pads and that is dabbed away to the leg side, they run one and goes back for the second.
short of length, flicked away yet again for a single.
punched off the back foot to the fine-leg region, the fielder was squarer, he dived and stopped it.
bit of swing into the batsman, from the middle stump and that is left alone for the ump to call it a wide
over extra-cover and four! The pressure was building ever so slightly and they needed a four to relieve it Rahane gives himself room and hits it over the fielder within the circle
pitched up, Dravid gives himself some room and lofts him, one bounce to the long-off fielder.
short of length outside the off stump and punched to long of for a single
on the off stump and Dravid drives it to long-off for a single
well hit by Dravid, in the gap through the covers but Taylor does well to slide and prevent it from going to the fence. Only a single.
pitched right up for a change and that is driven down the ground for a single, to long-on
goes on to his back foot and punches it to long-off for a single
that variation, round arm action, but the batsman is on his back foot and plays it down the ground to long-on.
short of length, cut away to the sweeper off the back foot.
on the stumps, does not move his feet too much and that is played away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump and that keeps very low, Dravid wanted to cut it away but missed it and that signals the end of the over
outside the off-stump and that is punched away for a single
goes to his back foot, it was a shorter one yet again and he flicks it away for a couple of deep square-leg.
outside the off stump and shorter as well, Dravid is able to punch it through to wide long-off for a single
shortish yet again and that is defended by Rahane, on the back foot and they rush off for a single
short of length, punched off the back foot and they are off for a single
defended well into the covers and that calls for a Time-Out
lofted, almost like he was giving catching practice and that went through between the deep cover and long-off for a four. It was so well hit in the gap that it bisected both of them!
slower, keeps low and that is dabbed away to mid-wicket, but it was so gently hit that they came back for the second.
short ball, Dravid rocks back and cuts it to deep point for a single
a bit of round arm action, coming into the batsman and he misses it.
quicker on his pads, goes on to the back foot and plays it away to the leg side for a single
allows the ball to come to him, and opens the face of the bat, to third-man, touch of Jacques Kallis in that stroke.
whipped away yet again and that goes away to the fine-leg for a four. There was a short fine-leg fielder in place and it beat him comfortably.
gives himself some room, mistimes it a little, but goes to long-off for a single
outside the off stump and played it back to the bowler.
on the pads and that is whipped away to the deep square-leg region for a single
pitched right up and defended back by Rahane
On his pads and Dravid has flicked it away to deep square-leg for a four!
outside the off stump and played away to the third-man for a single
pitched right up to the batsman who digs it out back to the bowler.
on front foot and defends it back to the bowler.
what was that shot! 144.5 km/hr, short of a good length, not too short though and he has slogged it away over mid-wicket for a four
on the stumps, short of good length, Dravid pushes it to the off side, to mid-off and they are off for a single
outside the off-stump, dabs it away to point and rushes away for a single
146.7 km/hr, some pace that, on the middle stump, good length and driven to the short point fielder.
pitched up this time, varying his length and Dravid attempts at a straight drive, but goes on the bounce to the bowler.
good line, good length, makes Dravid go on to the back foot and defends it back
outside the off-stump, pitched right up to the ball and Dravid punched it away, that flew away but to the fielder
short from Yadav and that has been pulled  by Dravid and that goes to backward square-leg for a four.
outside the off-stump, swinging further away, 141.9 km/hr and wide called.
length ball, hit into the covers, wants a single but sent back by a "No!" from Dravid. Good first over from Morkel
another one outside the off-stump, short of length and he is on his back foot, defended into the covers
outside the off-stump and Rahane has a good, hard, long look at it and sees it through to the keeper.
short of length, 144.9 km/hr, and defended well on the back foot for the bowler to field on follow-through
well pitched up to Dravid as well and he goes for a drive, gets an inside edge on to his pads and is away for a single
pitched right up, outside the off stump and Rahane plays it to mid-off, quick single taken
another one outside the off stump and Dravid is disappointed not to get it away through the covers for a four. It was much like the fourth ball of the over but misses his timing.
pitched up, flicked away to the fence for another four! Beautiful stroke through mid-wicket and whistles away to the boundary
shot! four! This was not slower and Dravid's class shows, driven through the covers
wanted to cut it away yet again and it misses another cut shot.
pace (131.2 km/hr) and bounce! Dravid was looking to play forward, then wanted to cut it and missed.
pitched up and Dravid leans into his drive to mid-off to KP
shorter yet again and this time Dravid punches it to extra cover where he gets one.
short and smashed through the covers for four! Rocked well on the back foot...
off-stump, spinning away and keeps low, played away to the leg-side for a single
short this time and he rocks on to his back foot and cut away to the wide long off for a couple
on the stumps, drifting in and defended back
defended on the front foot into the covers
outside the off stump and defended in the covers to end the over
slight swing into the bat, he taps it gently to square leg for a single
pitched right up to the batsman, who goes on to the front foot and defended back to the bowler.
outside the off stump, on the back foot and defended it to mid-off.
poor ball, down the leg side and Rahane has flicked away the first ball he faces to the fine-leg fence for a four.
swinging into the batsman from outside the off stump and Dravid punches it back to the bowler to get his scoring started.
